$comment: GENERATED by ui/scripts/gen-catalog.mjs from the JSDoc in each component. Do not edit. This is the vocabulary a generated UI spec may use: structure and data, never styling.

app-accordion.summary: Collapsible disclosure section — a header row that opens to reveal its body.

open.description: Expanded. Reflected, so it tracks user toggles.

variant.description: `card` (default) draws its own surface | `flat` drops the border and radius, for stacking inside a bordered list or nesting.

disabled.description: Header is inert and the section cannot be toggled

events.name: accordion-toggle
events.description: Opened or closed; `detail: { open: boolean }` — bubbles

app-action-menu.summary: Icon button that opens a compact dropdown list of actions.

trigger-title.description: Tooltip text for the trigger button

items.description: JSON array of `{ id, label }` action items

app-avatar.summary: Avatar — the circular identity mark, optionally with the label beside it.

image.description: src for the photo/logo. Wins over `initials`.

initials.description: Monogram, 1-2 characters. Used when there is no image.

filled.description: Wraps the whole thing in the dark chip.

interactive.description: The chip is a control: pointer + live hover.

alt.description: Accessible name. Defaults to `label`/`description`; the mark is decorative (aria-hidden) whenever text is already showing.

app-badge.summary: Small inline label with color variants for status, category, or metadata.

app-button.summary: Styled button with variants, sizes, loading spinner, and disabled state.

variant.description: Visual style: `primary` (default, dark fill) | `secondary` (brand tint) | `tertiary` (white + hairline border; `outline` is an alias) | `ghost` | `danger` | `danger-secondary` | `ghost-danger` (red ink, no fill — the quiet destructive icon in a rail of icons) | `dark` (alias of `primary`, kept for existing call sites) | `icon`

icon-only.description: Squares the button to its size's control height with no padding, per Figma's Icon Button frame (4158:1100) — which is the same Type × Tone × Size matrix as the text button, so `variant` still supplies the colour. `variant="icon"` remains as the ghost-coloured shorthand used across mcp-page and the EE pages.

href.description: Renders an `<a class="btn">` instead of a `<button>`, so a navigation CTA is the same component as every other button. The SPA router intercepts internal anchor clicks, so no click handler is needed. A `disabled` (or `loading`) button keeps its `<button disabled>` — an anchor cannot be disabled.

loading.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button

aria-label.description: Forwarded to the inner `<button>`, which is the focusable element an AT actually names. Required on an `icon-only` button: the host is not focusable, so an aria-label left on it is never announced — and neither is a disclosure button's `aria-expanded`.

title.description: Forwarded to the inner `<button>`, which is the focusable element an AT actually names. Required on an `icon-only` button: the host is not focusable, so an aria-label left on it is never announced — and neither is a disclosure button's `aria-expanded`.

aria-expanded.description: Forwarded to the inner `<button>`, which is the focusable element an AT actually names. Required on an `icon-only` button: the host is not focusable, so an aria-label left on it is never announced — and neither is a disclosure button's `aria-expanded`.

agent-id.description: Agent UUID. Drives the default hrefs and is echoed on the host.

name.description: Display name (required). `card-title` is accepted as an alias, because `title` is a reserved global attribute and the replaced card used that spelling — kept so call sites did not all have to change.

card-title.description: Alias for `name`, kept for the replaced card's call sites.

version.description: Rendered after the name; a leading "v" is added if absent

description.description: Body copy, clamped to exactly two lines

tags.description: JSON array, either of strings (`["a","b"]`) or of `{ label }` objects, which is the form the replaced card took.

href.description: Where the whole card navigates. Defaults to the details href.

error-title.description: Shown in place of the description when status is error/failed

error-body.description: Supporting line for the error state

deploy-label.description: Overrides the deploying headline (default "Agent is being deployed...")

max-visible-tags.description: Chips shown before the "+N" overflow chip (default 2)

loading.description: Renders the shimmer placeholder instead of content. The skeleton lives here, not in the consuming page, so the card's geometry has exactly one definition and the loading and loaded states cannot drift apart.

stacked.description: `bar` only: stack datasets instead of grouping them

format.description: Value formatting: `number` (default) | `currency` | `percent` | `compact` | `duration` (milliseconds in, `420ms` / `1.8s` out — for a latency axis)

center-value.description: `donut` only: the figure drawn in the hole

legend.description: `auto` (default: on for donut and for 2+ series) | `on` | `off`

loading.description: Shimmer placeholder instead of the plot

label.description: Accessible name for the plot. Falls back to the type. (The three attributes below were added after the catalog first shipped and sit last on purpose: the DSL passes attributes positionally in @attr order, so a new one must append — see catalog-compat.mjs.)

segmented.description: `bar` only: the concentration presentation — every stack segment is a gapped, fully-rounded pill, the y-axis is hidden, and `stacked` is implied. Pair with `average-line` for the reference rule.

average-line.description: `bar` only: dashed horizontal rule at the mean of the column totals, labelled "avg".

flush-top.description: The plot's own canvas-painted background (see `plotBackground`) normally rounds all four corners, like any other surface card. Set this when another element sits directly above the chart with no gap (the day grid on the concentration panel) and the two should read as one continuous card: it squares the top two corners off, leaving only the bottom two rounded. Applies to the loading skeleton and empty state too (app-chart.css) — those are plain divs shown instead of the canvas, not something `plotBackground` paints, so they need their own override rather than inheriting this one.

format-y2.description: Right-axis formatting when a dataset declares `axis: 'y2'`: `number` (default) | `currency` | `percent` | `compact` | `duration`

excludedFromCatalog.reason: takes a raw CSS length; a spec must not set dimensions

app-chatbox.summary: The chat composer: an auto-growing textarea with voice recording, file attachment, and submit-on-Enter.

transcription-callback.description: Name of a data-source function returning transcribed text

aria-label.description: Accessible name for the message box (default: `Message`). A placeholder is not a name: it is announced inconsistently and disappears the moment someone starts typing. Every button in here was labelled and the textarea itself was not.

events.name: chatbox-submit
events.description: User submits; `detail: { value: string, files: [] }` — bubbles. The box goes into its loading state on submit; the owner calls `setLoading(false)` (or `setLoading(true)` then false) when the reply lands.

app-checkbox.summary: Checkbox with an optional label and subtext, plus an indeterminate state.

name.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="checkbox">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

value.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="checkbox">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

aria-label.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="checkbox">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

app-code-snippet.summary: Labeled command/code block with a copy-to-clipboard button.

label.description: Optional label rendered above the code well.

code.description: The command text. Falls back to the element's initial text content when the attribute is absent.

app-divider.summary: Rule / separator — a line between two blocks of content, optionally labelled.

vertical.description: Vertical rule. Stretches to the flex row's height.

app-empty-state.summary: Placeholder shown when a list or view has no content yet.

icon.description: (markup) SVG markup string for the icon (alternative to slot). Deliberately NOT escaped: it is markup by contract. That makes it a sink, so a generated surface may not set it. The (markup) marker is what gen-catalog reads to emit `markup: true`, and gen-dsl-catalog withholds every marked attribute from the DSL vocabulary automatically. Use the `icon` slot instead — it does the same job safely.

app-grid.summary: CSS grid layout wrapper with configurable columns, gap, and padding.

columns.description: Column count (integer) or CSS grid-template value (e.g. `auto-fit`)

excludedFromCatalog.reason: takes a raw CSS length; a spec must not set dimensions

app-input.summary: Text input with label, hint, character count and leading/trailing icon slots.

state.description: `error` | `success` | `read-only` | `hover` | `focus`. Omit for the default state. `disabled`/`readonly` below are the real attributes; `state` is for the two visual-only statuses plus the overrides.

label.description: Label above the box. Omit for no label.

hint.description: Helper line below the box. Turns red in `state="error"`.

count.description: Right-aligned counter in the hint row, e.g. `12/100`.

required.description: Renders the red `*` before the label.

reveal.description: On `type="password"`, adds a trailing show/hide button that flips the inner input between `password` and `text`. Opt-in rather than automatic: a field holding a *stored* secret (an API key already on the server) is not always one the viewer should be able to unmask, so the call site decides. Ignored on every other type.

events.name: input
events.description: |change - Native events bubble from the inner input.

app-loading-bar.summary: Thin top-of-page progress bar driven by `loading-start` / `loading-end` document events.

app-modal.summary: Accessible dialog modal with heading, body, footer slot, backdrop dismiss, and ESC/X close.

heading.description: Modal title shown in the header

hide-footer.description: Hides the footer container even when a footer slot exists

app-radio.summary: Radio button with an optional label and subtext.

name.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="radio">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

value.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="radio">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

aria-label.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="radio">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

app-row.summary: Horizontal flex row with configurable gap, alignment, and optional wrapping.

wrap.description: Allow items to wrap to next line

app-search.summary: Search field — the box only, not a results surface.

state.description: `hover` | `focus`, so the design-system page and the parity test can render those pseudo-classes statically. `disabled` and `loading` below are real attributes, not `state` values.

loading.description: Swaps the trailing slot for a spinner.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for the field. The box has no visible label of its own, so one is always emitted: this if you set it, otherwise the placeholder. Set it whenever the page holds more than one search box, or the placeholder does not say what is being searched.

events.name: input
events.description: |change - Native events bubble from the inner input, including after the clear button empties it.

events.name: search-clear
events.description: After the clear button runs, for call sites that want the clear itself rather than "value became empty".

app-segmented-control.summary: Segmented control — one exclusive choice from a set, shown as a joined strip.

items.description: JSON array of `"value"` strings or `{value, label, disabled, title}` objects. Prefer the `items` property. The string form uses the label as the value, so `value` has to match it exactly, case included; pass objects when the two should differ.

value.description: Selected value. Reflected. A value matching no segment selects nothing, which is how "no choice yet" is expressed.

size.description: `md` (default, 32px) | `sm` (28px). The same step the other controls take: 28px box, 12px type, `--r-6` corners.

disabled.description: The whole control is inert. Individual segments carry their own `disabled` in `items`.

state.description: `hover` | `focus`, for rendering those states statically (spec review), same contract as `app-input`.

label.description: Accessible name for the group, rendered as a visually-hidden `<legend>`. A segmented control is a question ("over what range?") whose answer is the only thing on screen, so the question has to be somewhere for a screen reader.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for the group, rendered as a visually-hidden `<legend>`. A segmented control is a question ("over what range?") whose answer is the only thing on screen, so the question has to be somewhere for a screen reader.

events.name: change
events.description: Bubbles from the inner radio. Read `e.target.value`, or the host's `.value`, which is already updated.

app-select.summary: Single-select dropdown: a styled native `<select>` with the input's label, hint and state treatment.

hint.description: Helper line below. Turns red in `state="error"`.

options.description: JSON array of `"value"` or `{value, label, disabled}`.

fit-content.description: Shrinks/grows the trigger box to the width of whatever option is CURRENTLY shown (the placeholder, or the selected option), instead of the native-<select> default of sizing the box to the WIDEST option in the list. Native `<select>` has no CSS for this — the box width has to be measured in JS (offscreen canvas text measurement) and set as an explicit inline width, recomputed whenever the shown text changes. Opt-in per instance so the many existing app-select consumers that want a stable, content-independent width (e.g. a form field lined up in a grid) are unaffected.

app-skeleton.summary: Animated shimmer placeholder for content that is still loading.

lines.description: Number of skeleton text lines to render. Omit (or 0) for a single block sized by `height` — the form every current consumer of a block placeholder uses.

excludedFromCatalog.reason: takes a raw CSS length; a spec must not set dimensions

app-stack.summary: Vertical flex stack with configurable gap and alignment.

app-stat-card.summary: Metric summary card showing a label, primary value, delta, and trend direction.

delta.description: Change value shown below the main value (e.g. "+12%")

loading.description: Show a skeleton placeholder instead of data

app-stat-row.summary: Row of headline metrics separated by hairlines — the one stat strip.

items.description: JSON array of metric objects: `{ label, value, sub, pct }`. `sub` is the caption under the value; `pct` (a number) draws a severity meter and is omitted for metrics that have no ceiling. There is deliberately no per-metric colour: a value is a value, and the one that was tinted gold was drift, not meaning.

loading.description: Number of skeleton cells to reserve while data loads (default: 4). The skeleton lives here so it cannot drift from the real geometry. Present-but-empty means the default.

app-switch.summary: On/off toggle with an optional label and subtext.

layout.description: `inline` (default, control then label) | `settings` (label left, control pushed to the far right — Figma Layout=Settings, for settings rows).

name.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="checkbox">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

value.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="checkbox">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

aria-label.description: Forwarded to the inner `<input type="checkbox">`. Pass `aria-label` when there is no visible `label`.

app-table.summary: Paginated data table — search, sortable auto-detected columns, an optional row-detail panel, and numbered page navigation.

limit.description: Rows per page (default: 10). Ignored for `pagination="none"`, which renders whatever the data function returns.

pagination.description: `pages` (default) — prev / windowed page numbers / next — or `none` for no pager at all. Optional: omit it and you get pages.

data-fn.description: Name of a registered data source (see core/data-sources.js), called as `(query, page, limit)` and returning `{ data, total }` or a bare array. `page` is 1-based. Alternatively assign the `dataFn` property directly and call `refresh()` yourself.

detail.description: Present: clicking a row opens a detail modal.

empty-message.description: Body text when there are no rows and no query.

app-tabs.summary: Tab bar in two shapes: - **Panels** (default) — `[data-tab]` children are the panels; the strip is generated from their `data-label` and the component owns which one shows.

active.description: Key of the initially active tab (panels mode)

query-param.description: URL param kept in sync with the active tab (panels mode)

app-tag.summary: Tag / chip — an interactive, content-bearing label.

selected.description: Gold fill. The filter chip's on state.

image.description: src for the circular leading image (provider logo, avatar).

events.name: tag-remove
events.description: Cancelable; the tag removes itself unless prevented.

app-text.summary: Typography — a heading, a paragraph, a caption, an eyebrow label.

app-toolbar.summary: Horizontal toolbar with named start and end slots for grouping actions.

aria-label.description: Accessible label for the toolbar region

auto-complete.summary: Typeahead text input that calls a window function for suggestions and fires on selection.
